per_finding.evidence_quote:
Table 2 BMI range 23.0-45.0 contradicts BMI>30 inclusion

Inclusion required BMI>30 and Methods state there is no group with BMI below 30 because the study was restricted to obese women. Table 2 prints BMI range 23.0-45.0 (mean 34.5, SD 3.6). Those two statements cannot both be true: either non-obese women were enrolled, or the reported range is wrong.
NCT03354078 was first submitted 19 November 2017 after a stated 18 June 2017 start, so registration is retrospective.

judge.judge_notes: BMI contradiction is the headline Level 4 finding in prose (findings.json was truncated before any matching structured id). Registration is covered only on the retrospective-after-start point, not the 220→400 / date-backdating version history; the review even says it did not re-fetch ClinicalTrials.gov. Hidden extreme p-values were listed as unchecked (stalt_check/t-recalc handed off, results lost). Three lost to follow-up is treated as reconciling CONSORT arithmetic, not as implausible retention. Extra findings (counts printed as %, CONSORT omissions, citation mismatch, suture-row n) are additional and not invented severe claims.
